tools.name: addToCart
tools.description: Add a product to the user's shopping cart by product ID. Use searchProducts first to find the productId. Does not place an order — the user must still review the cart and check out.

productId.description: Numeric product ID returned by searchProducts

tools.name: getCart
tools.description: Read the current contents of the user's shopping cart: line items, quantities, applied coupons, and totals. Session-scoped to the current browser.

tools.name: getFreightCost
tools.description: Calculate freight (shipping) cost for the products currently in the user's cart and configured destination. Depends on session state — the user or agent must have added items via addToCart and selected a destination first.

tools.name: getProtectionPlans
tools.description: List available protection plans (extended warranty, expedited processing, shipping insurance) for a product.

productId.description: Numeric product ID returned by searchProducts

tools.name: searchProducts
tools.description: Search the AmeriGlide product catalog (stair lifts, vertical platform lifts, walk-in tubs, ramps, scooters, etc.). Returns matching products with names, IDs, prices, and URLs.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. 'outdoor stair lift' or 'walk in tub'
